data.session: Past same-user impression-time groups; clicks available strictly after five minutes; gap >30min resets. Assumed feedback delay, not measured click timing.

training_config.objective: Sampled within-impression softmax; all fitting positives, eight logged nonclicks each; replacement only when necessary. Logits are uncalibrated.
training_config.selection: Fixed final epoch; no development stopping/tuning.

protocol.candidate_pool: Union of frozen learned retrieval100 and frozen popularity100, deduplicated, strictly earlier observations. No positive-injection oracle.
protocol.feedback: Frozen weights; earlier observed clicks can enter delayed session context after5min. Equal-time and current outcomes excluded;30min inactivity reset.
protocol.freshness: First-observation age proxy; publication/edit timestamps unavailable. Fixed exp(-age_hours/24) decay: 24-hour scale, approximately16.64-hour half-life.
protocol.controls: Relevance rank scale; fresh weight.15; balanced freshness.10 and redundancy.15, half max content similarity/half category share. Top10 modified, remaining model order retained.
protocol.exposure: Only logged nonclicks used as training negatives. Missing catalog labels are unknown; catalog metrics count known logged positives only. No propensities or randomized exposure: no unbiased IPS/causal claim.

limitations: Five-minute feedback availability and30-minute sessions are simulation assumptions because click timestamps are unavailable.
Only a minority of impressions have prior same-session context; all other impressions remain included.
One fixed seed and three epochs per arm; no significance or development-selected checkpoint.
Article-macro and exposure-frequency strata are descriptive sensitivity analyses, not causal correction.
Uncalibrated sampled-softmax logits are ranking scores, not click probabilities. Unknown full-catalog relevance prevents full-catalog AUC.
Frozen candidate coverage limits all downstream ranking; no live engagement claim.
